scientific_integrity: Proof and test code are supplied; finite computational tests are corroborative rather than universal proofs. This has not received independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite chains and independent equal-rate Poisson copying resets with pinned root only.
Independent centered square-integrable Levy disturbances; no correlated downstream noise, nonlinearities, or infinite-chain stationary assertion.
Root-to-descendant raw two-time covariances only; downstream-normalized correlations depend on additional noise strengths.
Publication priority remains subject to broader primary literature and independent assessment.
title: A universal delayed covariance pulse in nested resetting chains
